'''Attros Finn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Doctor/Legends|medical researcher]] at the [[Jedi Embassy]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]], Attros Finn was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and [[Jedi Consular|Consular]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], Finn was stationed at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], using his unique skills as a [[Jedi healer/Legends|healer]] and a medical researcher to aid ailing Senators and Jedi. During this time, he was assisted by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and living medics, including a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] woman named [[Pharen]].

In [[3643 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]] was placed under his observation by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] after the esteemed master had succumbed to a [[Dark Plague|dangerous illness]]. While Finn attended to the ill and sometimes violent Jedi, her former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], a [[The Barsen'thor|recently knighted Jedi]], went in search of the lost [[Noetikon]]s, ancient [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifacts]] presumed to hold the answers to the illness.<ref name="SWTORTCD" />
